observations: Red 20kg-style LPG gas cylinder photographed lying in a car trunk/boot.
Surface shows rust spots, paint flaking, and scratches across the body.
Valve/regulator assembly visible at the neck but no close-up to check for damage or leaks.
No manufacturer plate, brand name, or test/certification date stamp legible in the photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOBODO PETER' overlays the image, not seller-applied metadata.
Item is surrounded by unrelated household items (brush, packaging) suggesting a casual/home setting, not a shop.

claims.evidence: Size cannot be confirmed from photo alone; no scale or marking visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: direct tokunbo (used/foreign-used import, implying good quality)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, origin marking, or proof shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Structural integrity compromised by visible rust/corrosion, could affect safety certification.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full body surface, especially base and weld seams, showing no pitting or thinning.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn with possible corrosion, lower tier

risks.risk: Valve may be damaged, leaking, or non-functional.
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of valve being opened/closed, and a soapy-water leak test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve condition unknown/not working

risks.risk: No test/certification date stamp visible, cylinder may be overdue for safety recertification.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped collar or shoulder showing manufacture/test date.

risks.risk: Actual cylinder capacity (20kg) unconfirmed; could be a smaller/mislabeled size.
risks.proof: Photo showing stamped capacity marking (kg) on the cylinder collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower-capacity worst case if marking not shown

risks.risk: Cylinder could be empty or only partially filled.
risks.proof: Weighing scale photo/video showing gross weight, or gas station fill receipt.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the collar/shoulder stamp showing capacity, manufacture date, and test date.
Clear photo or short video of the valve opening/closing and a leak test.
Full-body photos from multiple angles in better lighting to assess rust/dents.
Weighing scale photo to confirm current gas content.
response.reason: Item is identifiable by type as a 20kg LPG gas cylinder, but visible rust, absent certification/date stamp, and unverified valve condition mean it must be priced at worst case (uncertified, possibly empty, condition-worn) until further proof is supplied.
